messages:
maria: heads up — running into a weird HF->Redwood chat_template conversion edge. leading Jinja comments in system/instruction blocks are being removed entirely which collapses later assistant placeholders.

maria: repro snippet:
```jinja
{# pipeline: system metadata - do not render #}
{% set persona = 'concise' %}
- role: system
  content: |
    You are a helpful assistant.

- role: user
  content: |
    Summarize the metrics.
```

maria: after conversion the renderer produces a prompt chunk where the assistant/user separators shift — the initial comment line disappears and our template inserter treats the first block as user text. conversation roles get out of sync.

andrew: can you paste the converted output (raw) from the conversion pipeline? curious if comment stripping happens in the jinja pre-render or in the HF chat_template->rw adapter.

maria: converted output (from the hf->redwood converter):
```
You are a helpful assistant.

- role: user
  content: |
    Summarize the metrics.
```

maria: so the `{# ... #}` line is gone and we lose the intention that it was a comment; if there had been an empty assistant block after it, that empty marker is dropped too.

gopal: hmm — probable cause: our pre-render pass runs a quick regex to strip comments but only matches `^#` style comments, not Jinja `{#...#}` tokens, so we call `.strip()` on the whole block afterwards which collapses empty assistant placeholders. we've hit this before with other templating variants.

gopal: two quick hypotheses:
- the hf loader emits the jinja chat_template as a single mixed block and we run comment-cleanup that doesn't understand Jinja tokens
- or the tokenizer/special_tokens in `config.json` include an invisible sentinel that collides and gets removed when comment lines are present

sam: re reproducer — i saw eval regressions on the quantized 4-bit run because some prompts lost the system guard rails. small change but impacts rouge/accuracy in our bench. open to a quick fix.

andrew: can you attach the minimal test-case to a CI job and add an assert that `'{#'` comments survive conversion? also check `chat_template` variant with leading whitespace + `{#` on same line.

maria: done — https://ci.internal/runs/4521 (added a unit that renders hf chat_template -> rw prompt and compares tokens). failing locally.

gopal: quick patch idea: stop aggressive comment-stripping in the hf adapter; instead, parse the template with a jinja2.Environment and walk the AST. preserve Comment nodes as neutral whitespace tokens (or convert to `<!--COMMENT:...-->` sentinel) so downstream role detection keeps offsets.

andrew: sounds good. if we convert to a sentinel, make sure we update the tokenizer special_tokens_set in the model onboarding flow so tokenization doesn't split the sentinel mid-token.

render-bot: deploy: conversion-fix/patch-#2386 deployed to staging at 1949998908 — logs: 10/12 conversions ok, 2 expected diffs.

sam: ran eval quickbench on staging, quant-4bit no longer loses system prefix in 98% of cases. still some weirdness with multiline comments inside fenced blocks.

gopal: filed follow-up ticket to handle nested comment nodes and fenced block edgecases — tracking #2390.

maria: thanks all — I'll iterate on the nested-case tests. feel free to merge the staging patch to main once CI green. :thumbsup:
